fun_facts: Charlie Smyth was born in Newry, Ireland, and described himself as a young NFL fan from County Down.
Before becoming an NFL kicker, Charlie Smyth played Gaelic football as a goalkeeper for the Down county team at senior level.
Charlie Smyth had never kicked an American football until August 2023; he was already familiar with kicking frees in Gaelic football.
At 18, Charlie Smyth emailed the NFL to ask for a chance to show his kicking skills.
At a tryout with 20 kickers, Charlie Smyth was one of the final five specialists to advance.
In his NFL debut, Charlie Smyth made a 56-yard field goal and successfully executed an onside kick.

excerpts:
Irish eyes are smiling down on [Charlie Smyth](https://www.nfl.com/players/charlie-smyth/ "Charlie Smyth") following his NFL debut on Sunday, and the rookie's impressive performance might have locked him in as New Orleans Saints' primary kicker.

Smyth, an International Pathway Player out of Northern Ireland, was only called upon twice in [Sunday's 21-17 loss](https://www.nfl.com/games/saints-at-dolphins-2025-reg-13) to the Miami Dolphins, but the rookie was perfect on those instances -- connecting on a 56-yard field goal and booting a successful onside kick in the fourth quarter to prolong the Saints' comeback attempt.
